name: [QRPS] - Royal Imitation M9 Parts
teaser: Fancied a gold and jade M9? Well now you can show Reshala that *you* have the shinier pistol.
description_html:
An old Classic back from the AKI-B1 days, these beautiful weapon parts can be bought from Mechanic at LL1, so you can rock the bling right from the very start of the game. This deluxe package comes complete with a set of Slides and Grips, as well as a bonus Realism Patch, and the luxury feature of automatically being compatible with anything that takes the M9A3 grip sides/slide (As seen in the second pic, with a certain M9A1 that a few users may remember).

FAQ:

Where buy? Mechanic LL1.
Realism? Yes
Where original? Oddba
When M9A1? +1 week

What QRPS? Qwerty-Reaper Porting Service (Turns out there’s a bunch of old bundles on Oddba that never got updated, and we decided to port some of them, also I like acronyms.)

3.10 Compatible? No mongos, will go boom. Will fix when I upgrade to 3.10/when it comes out

Credits to the original author Star Sparse! We wouldn’t have this now if you didn’t originally make them!
